description:
Sau khi hợp tác với đại diện Epizode tại Việt Nam, một trong những lễ hội âm nhạc biển lớn nhất Đông Nam Á. description: "Nestled in the natural beauty of Phu Quoc Island, Phu Quoc Bee Farm is a place where visitors can immerse themselves in the fascinating world of honeybees and discover the vital role these remarkable creatures play in sustaining our food chain and ecosystem. We invite you to explore our bee-friendly habitats and learn firsthand how bees create honey, pollen, and beeswax. At Phu Quoc Bee Farm, we offer more than just honey. Sip on our home-brewed Honey Kombucha and other refreshing, health-focused drinks, or savor our homemade dishes crafted with care. Plus, take a piece of the experience home by purchasing our artisanal products, knowing that each item is made with love and respect for nature! We look forward to welcoming you to our farm!"
